Deepak Kumar S/O Shri Lalluram vs State Of Rajasthan
(2024:Rj-Jp:51000) on 11 December, 2024

Author: Anil Kumar Upman
Bench: Anil Kumar Upman

[2024:RJ-JP:51000]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 14805/2024 Deepak Kumar S/o Shri Lalluram, Aged About 37 Years, R/o Gadwas Khohra Malawali, P.s. Laxmangarh, Currently Residing At H.no. 12/13, Ram Nagar Colony, Bhagore, Rajgarh Road, P.s.
Sadar, District Alwar Rajasthan.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
(Presently Confined In Central Jail, Tonk)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through PP  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Hemant Sharma For Respondent(s) : Mr. S.R. Dhakar, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR UPMAN  Order 11/12/2024 1.

The instant bail application has been filed under Section 483 of BNSS on behalf of the petitioner,
who has been arrested in connection with FIR No. 394/2021 registered at Police Station Baroni,
District Tonk for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 474 and 120-B of IPC.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that alleged offence are triable by Magistrate.
Counsel submits that the main allegation against the petitioner is that the complainant/victim deposited Rs.5,00,000/- in his bank account on the inducement of the co-accused.
Counsel submits that petitioner is in custody since 16.10.2024.
Charge-sheet has already been filed and trial will take [2024:RJ-JP:51000] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-14805/2024] its considerable time.

Further custody of the petitioner would not serve any fruitful purpose.

entities.text: Deepak Kumar S/O Shri Lalluram vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jp:51000)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned PP opposes submissions made by counsel for the petitioner.
He submits that one other case has been registered against the petitioner for similar offence, therefore, the bail application of the petitioner may be dismissed.

5. Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case; considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the petitioner as also looking to the fact that the offences are triable by Magistrate; bail application of the co-accused Hansraj and Manraj has been accepted by the Coordinate Bench; charge- sheet has already been filed in this matter and the period of custody, but without commenting anything on the merits/demerits of the case, I deem it fit and proper to allow this bail application.
6. The observation made hereinabove is only for decision of the instant bail application and would not have any impact on the trial of the case in any manner.

7. This bail application is accordingly allowed and it is directed that accused-petitioner namely Deepak Kumar S/o Shri Lalluram shall be released on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) together with two sureties in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) each to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court with the stipulation that he shall appear before that Court and any court to which the matter is transferred, on all subsequent dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
[2024:RJ-JP:51000] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-14805/2024]
8.

It is made clear that the accused-petitioner shall not involve in any other offence(s) during currency of the bail and he shall mark his presence on first Monday of every three month in the concerned police station.
(ANIL KUMAR UPMAN),J Pcg/290 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
